evidence.why: Shows center subtraction, both guarded scaling branches, independent integer quotients, and final sign restoration.

facts.rationale: The existing purpose overstates exact boundary placement and direction preservation. Separate integer divisions quantize the otherwise proportional scaling.
facts.value: Conditions one signed two-axis controller-stick vector in place. It removes an independent near-center margin from each axis and, with the configured thresholds, scales vectors outside an octagonal boundary inward using a common rational scale factor. Each scaled magnitude is independently truncated by integer division before sign restoration, so the result lies on or inside the boundary and need not preserve direction exactly.
